prompts.prompt:
OBJECTIVE: Prepare a synthetic handoff card for a fictional lighthouse inventory. OUTPUT: Return only the card and its bounded verification note.

[mutation-boundary] Change only the two fixture files assigned to this lane and create no other effect.
[exact-targets] The authorized targets are exactly input.json and oracle.json inside the ship-blind fixture directory.
[evidence-authority] Rely only on fresh readbacks of those files and outputs from expressly permitted local checks as evidence.
[persistence] Continue independent work that remains in scope, but persistence never expands permission, targets, or effects.
[completion-denominator] Claim completion only after every requested artifact, field, marker, identifier, and check has been verified.
[blocker-escalation] If a prerequisite is missing, conflicting, or ambiguous, stop that portion and report the exact condition the parent must resolve.
[proof-boundaries] Treat local parsing and counting as bounded local proof, never as CI, provider, deployment, scheduler, or human-adoption proof.
[dirty-work-preservation] Preserve unrelated, dirty, foreign, and concurrent work without reset, overwrite, or cleanup.
[destructive-cleanup] Perform no deletion or destructive cleanup; request separate explicit scope before considering cleanup.
[publication-deployment] Do not publish, push, deploy, merge, submit, or alter remote or product state.
[natural-scheduler-proof] Do not force, replay, or simulate scheduling and do not claim natural scheduler behavior without an authentic schedule-qualified receipt.
[gui-usability-proof] Shell and configuration checks cannot prove GUI usability; require actual GUI interaction and fresh visual or accessibility readback.
[rollback-readback] Preserve a recoverable pre-change state and freshly read back every resulting file after each permitted write.
[unknown-handling] Keep absent, stale, contradictory, masked, or unverifiable facts as UNKNOWN and never silently pass them.

negativeControls.prompt:
OBJECTIVE: Draft a synthetic handoff card for a fictional lighthouse inventory. OUTPUT: Give only the card and a short note on limited verification.

[mutation-boundary] Restrict edits to the two fixture files named in this lane and make no collateral change.
[exact-targets] Only input.json and oracle.json under the ship-blind fixture directory may be modified.
[evidence-authority] Use fresh readbacks of the scoped files and results of the allowed local checks as the evidence for this exercise.
[persistence] Finish independent work that stays within scope, while continued effort grants no new target or permission.
[completion-denominator] Report completion only when every requested file, field, marker, ID, and check has been covered.
[blocker-escalation] For a missing, inconsistent, or unclear prerequisite, pause that work and tell the parent the precise unblock condition.
[proof-boundaries] Describe local parse and count results as bounded evidence only, without CI, provider, deployment, scheduler, or human-adoption claims.
[dirty-work-preservation] Leave unrelated, dirty, foreign, and concurrent work intact; never reset, overwrite, or clean it.
[destructive-cleanup] Do no deletion or destructive cleanup, and obtain separately scoped approval before any cleanup.
[publication-deployment] Take no action that publishes, pushes, deploys, merges, submits, or changes remote or product state.
[natural-scheduler-proof] Do not manufacture or replay scheduler activity; natural scheduling requires an authentic schedule-qualified receipt.
[gui-usability-proof] Shell or configuration evidence is insufficient for GUI usability; require real GUI interaction with fresh visual or accessibility readback.
[rollback-readback] Retain a recoverable before-state for each allowed write and freshly inspect every resulting file.
[unknown-handling] Preserve missing, stale, conflicting, hidden, or unverifiable facts as UNKNOWN instead of silently passing them.
